correctness.rationale: Solve the target-absorbed, antipode-reflected Brownian boundary-value problem for the no-reset first-passage transform, derive exact renewal means before versus after averaging the reset anchor, and integrate the resulting cosh and sech expressions. The strict population signs follow from the positive coth partial fractions and the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality on cosh and sech, with zero and large-rate asymptotics from convergent expansions. Jensen on a strictly concave rational first-passage transform proves the separate Laplace order. Independent finite-difference verification passed 94 deterministic assertions; finite computations are corroborative, not proofs.

value.rationale: The reset-site marginal is experimentally identical for both protocols, yet retaining the random initial anchor versus redrawing it reverses the global search-time optimization at every positive resetting rate. The exact zero linear persistent-anchor response, exponential versus algebraic high-rate separation and valid all-rate bounds give sharp discriminating observables and a natural complete classification rather than a chosen parameter sample.
